tool.name: MFA Merge
tool.command:
@PREPARE_ENV@ @PREPARE_DICTIONARY@
cp '$dict_arg' final_dict.dict &&
#for $other in $other_dicts: ln -sf '$other.dictionary_file' other_dict.dict && mfa model add_words final_dict.dict other_dict.dict && #end for
true
tool.help:
**Montreal Forced Aligner: Merge**
This tool merges pronunciation dictionaries.
The result will be a new dictionary with all words from all of the input dictionaries.
Typically, you will use this tool to extend one of the built-in dictionaries, e.g. with domain-specific vocabulary. The tool can also be used to copy one of the built-in dictionaries into your history by not adding any other dictionary.
**Limitations**
The tool is built on the `mfa model add_words` command and shares its limitations, i.e.:
- Merging will only succeed if the first dictionary already contains all the phones found in all of the other dictionaries. - It is only possible to add completely new words, not alternate pronunciations for existing words.
Merging happens sequentially in the order in which the dictionaries are specified. When the algorithm encounters a word to merge that already exists in the compiled dictionary at this point, it simply keeps the existing record. In other words, the first pronunciation of a word that is seen will win.
